meta.title: Ie · A traditional Kyoto house in Fushimi
meta.description: Ie is a traditional Kyoto house in Fushimi, given a new chapter. Come for tea, or come to stay.

heading: Ie
lines: IE (家) means home — a place of belonging, comfort, and everyday life.

doors.title: IE Stays
doors.line: Stay in thoughtfully restored Japanese houses, where heritage meets contemporary comfort. Discover the rhythms of everyday Kyoto, beyond the familiar tourist trails.

doors.title: IE House of Tea
doors.line: A house devoted to tea, seasonal flavours and the quiet rituals of everyday Kyoto. Discover thoughtfully prepared teas, food and moments of connection in a traditional machiya in Fushimi.
